keyFindings.description: A failed comment-recipient or primary-author query (lookups.go:228-237, failRecipients) leaves the event with a list cut short at that step (publisher.go:722-727), and planChains holds the owner's later events only on keys in an earlier event's list, so a later event of the same issue reaches a thread or document session (e.g. a comment.resolved through rootCommentAuthor) before the failed reply, which reaches it on retry: per-(owner, destination) order broken through a failed publish and its retry. Before the merge every lookup failure failed the batch.

loadDocumentSessionAuthors failing (documentCreditsSQL's jsonb_array_elements refusing a non-array credit list, #2366's breakDocumentCredits case) fails the whole batch; the event is never recorded, stays the lowest fresh id, and every later batch fails on it, so the outbox publishes nothing until the row is repaired. Main's #2366 rule backs off only that event.

Not-due events' ids enter the batch's wanted sets, so one event backed off on a broken thread or issue row fails every reply of every batch that reads its owner's window, where on main it fails only when due again.

No test pins resolveLost: TestAStoppingBatchReleasesTheEventsWhoseRecipientQueryFailed seeds fresh events whose unsent owner-topic sends release them anyway, so replacing resolveLost with false still passes; a case whose earlier destinations are already in published_destinations would pin it.
